language.name: Dza
language.location: Jen town, Karim-Lamido LGA, Taraba State, Nigeria

cardinal.dza: nwutsɨng ji bwali yantsɨ hywa bwatə

genitive.alienable: marker və̀: ìdzwa və̀ Nlabe = Nlabe's dog

tense_aspect.non_past: n (after subject pronoun): sɨn wulɨ = is coming
tense_aspect.perfective: yang (completed action): chi yang = found already
tense_aspect.habitual: sɨn + verb: sɨn tswekə = does/is doing
tense_aspect.progressive: sɨn + verb + lɨ: sɨn wulɨ = is coming
tense_aspect.imperative_pl: ba + verb: ba wu = come (you all)!

grammar.negation: verb + lo: yi wə lo = did not know him
grammar.relative_clause: nɨ marks relative: ifɨ nɨ wu = person who came
grammar.copula: dɨ...kə: Dɨ mə kə Ivə = You are the King
grammar.conditional: aba...yang: Aba a yipɨ yang = If you knew
grammar.purpose: hɛbələ = so that, bisɨ = because/in order to
grammar.question_formation: add wəde (who), bede (what), bě (where), tswe wũ/nwu (why)
grammar.reported_speech: tsa + quote: o tsa 'dɨ mi kə...' = he said 'I am...'

key_phrases.dza: N bə Shetan wana o dzwe ma mɛmɛ
key_phrases.english: I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven

key_phrases.dza: Bə dɨ e ifɨ pərkə, bə nɨ nɨng ba bəkə e nɨng nɨ
key_phrases.english: Blessed are the eyes that see what you see

key_phrases.dza: Fi ta və bɨ dzwe, e tə dzung mə kãlɨ
key_phrases.english: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name

key_phrases.dza: Ivə mə wu
key_phrases.english: Your kingdom come

key_phrases.dza: A tə bɨ nɨngtang kəvivi
key_phrases.english: Give us our daily bread

key_phrases.dza: A e nyi mə hywa ku nɨng abe və bɨ
key_phrases.english: Forgive us our sins

key_phrases.dza: Bi man yə bɨ bɨn o sɨ pɨ hãpɨ yɛ
key_phrases.english: Lead us not into temptation

key_phrases.dza: Ba kũ pɨ en tə bə tə
key_phrases.english: Ask and it will be given to you

key_phrases.dza: Ba bapɨ, ban chichi
key_phrases.english: Seek and you will find

key_phrases.dza: Ba gbə na nwakwə, en be bə lə be
key_phrases.english: Knock and the door will be opened

key_phrases.dza: Mə Danhywɛ! Man bwibwi be nvi nɨ
key_phrases.english: You fool! Tonight your life will be demanded

key_phrases.dza: Ba bə e kɨnka, en pyənɨng lo
key_phrases.english: Consider the ravens, they don't sow

key_phrases.dza: Pɨnɨ jɔdi mə tsɨkə nɨ, dɨ pɨde nyi mə tsɨ pɨ bi
key_phrases.english: Where your treasure is, there your heart will be

key_phrases.dza: Iye, sɨshi ma tɨng yang!
key_phrases.english: Woman, you are set free!

key_phrases.dza: Ba mwə nwakwə a təlɨ ba tə tangsə Ivə və Fi
key_phrases.english: Enter through the narrow door

key_phrases.dza: E ifɨ nwachi yin myɛkə e ichi tswa
key_phrases.english: The first will be last, the last first

key_phrases.dza: Dɨ bə Urushalima, Urushalima
key_phrases.english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem

key_phrases.dza: Efo bə myɛ bə yə nɨng abe, bə ma ban bwibwi mambɨ
key_phrases.english: Unless you repent, you will perish

key_phrases.dza: Bi ban bibi və e ifɨ yɛ, ba bibi və Fi
key_phrases.english: Don't fear people, fear God

key_phrases.dza: Ifɨ nɨ tsung be mi lo hɛ̃, son wənyi mi
key_phrases.english: Whoever is not with me is against me

key_phrases.dza: Dɨ mi kə nɨhyã, dɨ mi kə bi anɨng, fə dɨ mi kə hũlɨ
key_phrases.english: I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life

key_phrases.dza: Ke ifɨ nɨ bə mi hɛ̃, o bə Ta yang
key_phrases.english: Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father

key_phrases.dza: Min tə pɨ mə pɨ kulɨ bisɨ bə
key_phrases.english: I go to prepare a place for you

key_phrases.dza: Mi dɨ kə inabi, bə dɨ e kəna kə
key_phrases.english: I am the vine, you are the branches

key_phrases.dza: Ifɨ tə ku wə bisɨ e tswə wə
key_phrases.english: No greater love than to lay down life for friends

key_phrases.dza: Min dzu bə e mwanshə lo, be e tswə
key_phrases.english: I no longer call you servants, but friends

key_phrases.dza: N le Fangwa yang
key_phrases.english: I have overcome the world

key_phrases.dza: A tã wu bə lə!
key_phrases.english: Peace be with you!

key_phrases.dza: Itwe mi, be Fi mi!
key_phrases.english: My Lord and my God!

key_phrases.dza: E ifɨ nɨ bəkə lo be tsɨnyi lə nɨ dɨ e ifɨ pərkə
key_phrases.english: Blessed are those who believe without seeing

key_phrases.dza: Sima yɨ Yohana sɨ man tswebi mi?
key_phrases.english: Simon son of John, do you love me?

key_phrases.dza: A tə e nɨngpungga mi nɨngtang
key_phrases.english: Feed my sheep

key_phrases.dza: A mwə tswa mi
key_phrases.english: Follow me (confirmed)

key_phrases.dza: Dɨ mi (I AM)
key_phrases.english: I am / It is I

key_phrases.dza: Lɨng le mi yang
key_phrases.english: I am thirsty

key_phrases.dza: Tɨng yang
key_phrases.english: It is finished

key_phrases.dza: Ivə mi dɨ a Fangwa nɨ lo
key_phrases.english: My kingdom is not of this world

key_phrases.dza: N chi wə be ayibe lo
key_phrases.english: I find no guilt in this man

key_phrases.dza: Dɨ ibwi de ho nɨ!
key_phrases.english: Behold the man!

key_phrases.dza: Ba pi wə ku kə!
key_phrases.english: Crucify him!

key_phrases.dza: Raboni!
key_phrases.english: Teacher! (Mary to risen Jesus)

key_phrases.dza: Bi man bibi yɛ, a tsɨnyi sɨ mi!
key_phrases.english: Don't doubt, believe!

key_phrases.dza: Nɨngnɨ n vĩkə nɨ, n vĩ yang
key_phrases.english: What I have written, I have written

key_phrases.dza: Ba chi Kwang Fi
key_phrases.english: Receive the Holy Spirit

key_phrases.dza: Bi nyi mə gbəshə bisɨ mi yɛ, a tsɨnyi sɨ mi!
key_phrases.english: Stop doubting and believe!

key_phrases.dza: N bə Itwebɨ yang!
key_phrases.english: I have seen the Lord!

key_phrases.dza: Ke ifɨ nɨ dɨ ku wə kə nɨng akə hɛ̃, en fə be wə hywa
key_phrases.english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled

key_phrases.dza: Wu ba pələ mi be bɛlɨ, bisɨ nɨngpunga mi nɨ ləkə nɨ, n chi wə yang
key_phrases.english: Rejoice with me, I found my lost sheep

key_phrases.dza: Ta mi, n tswe ayibe yang sɨ Fi dzwe be pɨpi mə
key_phrases.english: Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you

key_phrases.dza: Yɨ mi bwi yang bɨ fə wu nɨ. O la bɨ fə e chi wə nɨ
key_phrases.english: My son was dead and is alive, was lost and is found

key_phrases.dza: Ifɨ sɨn tswe shə və e ifɨ yung lo
key_phrases.english: No one can serve two masters

key_phrases.dza: Yeso! Itwevə! A bəshi bɨ!
key_phrases.english: Jesus! Master! Have mercy on us!

key_phrases.dza: Ivə və Fi le tangsə bə
key_phrases.english: The Kingdom of God is within you

key_phrases.dza: Fi, a bəshi mi, bisɨ mi dɨ ifɨ nɨng abe
key_phrases.english: God, have mercy on me, a sinner

key_phrases.dza: Ba yə e imwə yangshang wu sɨ mi
key_phrases.english: Let the little children come to me

key_phrases.dza: N wu bisɨ n bapɨ nɨng nɨ la kə nɨ n ji be le ku
key_phrases.english: The Son of Man came to seek and save the lost

key_phrases.dza: Hĩkwã ba tə Kaisar nɨngnɨ a və Kaisar, fə ba tə Fi nɨngnɨ a və Fi
key_phrases.english: Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's

key_phrases.dza: Dɨ sɨ mi nɨ, e ta bisɨ bə. Ba tswe mambɨ bisɨ ba nyibi be mi
key_phrases.english: This is my body given for you. Do this in remembrance of me

key_phrases.dza: Kofi nɨ dɨ ndɛ̃ və Fi a hu nɨ o tsəkə be hywi mi
key_phrases.english: This cup is the new covenant in my blood

key_phrases.dza: Ta mi, a e nyi mə hywa sɨ e ifɨ nɨ, bisɨ e yi nɨngnɨ sen tswekə nɨ lo
key_phrases.english: Father, forgive them, for they don't know what they're doing

key_phrases.dza: Jɛnɨ man ku tsung be mi PU KƏ CHƐ̃ və Fi
key_phrases.english: Today you will be with me in Paradise

key_phrases.dza: Ta mi, min tə kwəng mi le kənə mə!
key_phrases.english: Father, into your hands I commit my spirit

key_phrases.dza: Kə a kəng Itwebɨ yi yang!
key_phrases.english: The Lord has risen indeed!

key_phrases.dza: Tswe nwu sɨ ba bapɨ ifɨ be hũlɨ tũ lɨ?
key_phrases.english: Why do you seek the living among the dead?

key_phrases.dza: Ba midzwi hywa Urushalima pəko ba chi sambe
key_phrases.english: Stay in Jerusalem until you receive power from on high

key_phrases.dza: Parkə dɨ a və ivə nɨ wukə bisɨ dzung Itwebɨ!
key_phrases.english: Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord!

key_phrases.dza: Təngvə mi dɨ pɨ pinwa
key_phrases.english: My house shall be a house of prayer

key_phrases.dza: Dɨ ibwi de ho nɨ!
key_phrases.english: Behold the man! (Luke variant, Pilate)

kə bɨ bɨmpo sɨ bɨn e a bɨ nyi bɨ hywa sɨ e ifɨ nɨ sɨn tswe bɨ ayibe lə nɨ.
lines.english: as we also forgive everyone who sins against us.

lines.english: Do not lead us into temptation,
